derivation_requirements.name: SITEGR1 pooling counts RANDOMIZED (ITTFL='Y') subjects
derivation_requirements.rule: Pool a site into SITEGR1='900' when ANY planned arm at that site has < 3 randomized (ITTFL='Y') subjects. Count randomized subjects, NOT all enrolled — enrolled includes screen failures.
derivation_requirements.why: Counting all-enrolled produces the wrong site groups and a different ANCOVA result.
derivation_requirements.study_specific: WARNING: with 17 randomized subjects across 6 sites (701/704/708/710/711/718) and 3 arms, NO site can have >=3 randomized subjects in every arm. This rule will pool EVERY site into 900, leaving SITEGR1 with a single level. A single-level factor is rank-deficient and will be dropped from the ANCOVA model. sdtm-to-adam MUST apply the rule as written, report the resulting group count, and let the generator handle the degenerate covariate (refit without SITEGR1 and footnote it). Do NOT weaken the threshold to manufacture variation.
derivation_requirements.location: ADSL; cascades to every table using site as a covariate or stratifier.
derivation_requirements.assert: Report the number of distinct SITEGR1 values. Expected here: 1 (all pooled). Any other value means the rule was not applied on randomized counts.

notes: 18 DM records: 17 randomized + 1 screen failure (blank ARM). RANDFL/ITTFL must exclude the screen failure.
ACTARM equals ARM for every subject in this extract — no as-treated deviations.
DTHCAUS requires a join to SDTM DD (3 records).

Conformance correction (metatools::check_variables, 2026-07-29): ARMCD, ACTARMCD, TRTP, AGEU and AGEGR1N were derived but not enumerated in this spec. TRTP in particular is the grouping variable every analysis-spec entry references, so its omission was a real spec defect. Added.

derivation_requirements.name: Day-based analysis-visit windowing that never drops unscheduled/ET visits

derivation_requirements.name: LOCF record creation at the endpoint visit
derivation_requirements.rule: For every subject in the analysis population with a baseline (ABLFL='Y') and >=1 post-baseline value but NO observed record at the endpoint visit, carry the last observed post-baseline value forward as a new record at the endpoint AVISITN with DTYPE='LOCF' and ANL01FL='Y'. Exactly ONE record with ANL01FL='Y' per subject per parameter per endpoint.
derivation_requirements.why: Without it the LOCF tables silently analyze only completers.
derivation_requirements.study_specific: CRITICAL HERE. Only 2 subjects have an observed Week 24 PHQ-9 or SWLS total against 13 with a baseline; 6 have an EARLY DISCONTINUATION RETRIEVAL record.
